seed: The space between a zoom callout's two leader lines is tinted with the line colour at 10% by default, so the callout reads as one beam from the source to the magnifier; Fill opacity in the Lens section sets it and 0 turns it off. The user, 2026-10-13: I'd like the area in between to be filled the line color but be 10% opacity (configurable). Next defaults, no switch: Z is the Lens set to Magnify. Points are document points (1440 x 960); the callout made here lands at (444, 260, 240 x 160) from a 120 x 80 source.

steps.note: THE TEST: a new callout's band, between its two lines, is the line red at 10% over the picture
the magnified box dragged down and right: the band follows it, with its edges on the two lines
Shape Circle: the two lines just touch both circles and the band fills between them, stopping at both round edges
THE TEST for off: Fill opacity pulled all the way left by its face; the band is gone and the picture under it is untouched
one undo puts the band back at 10%
the next callout drawn after Fill opacity went to 0 comes out with no band: the tool took the number
